title: Shadows of Neon
logline: In a rain-soaked cyberpunk metropolis, a desperate man races against time to find his lost sibling across dimensions, navigating neon-lit alleyways and the dark underbelly of digital realms.
synopsis: In the neon-drenched streets of Neo-Victoria, a shadowy figure known only as 'Eli' is consumed by the relentless pursuit of his missing sister. Armed with a mysterious device that can traverse parallel dimensions, Eli delves into a world where reality warps and artificial intelligence dominates. Alongside an enigmatic hacker named 'Vesper,' Eli races against time to uncover the secrets behind his sister's disappearance before she falls into the clutches of a shadowy corporation intent on harnessing her powers for their own sinister ends.

characters.name: Eli
characters.description: A desperate man driven by the loss of his sister. He's haunted by vivid memories of her and is willing to do anything to find her, even venturing into parallel dimensions.

characters.name: Vesper
characters.description: A mysterious hacker with a deep understanding of technology and the digital realm. She becomes Eli's ally in his quest but harbors secrets of her own.
